//port: Serial port connected to your MeshCore radio device (e.g. COM11, /dev/ttyACM0)
//channels: Map of channel categories to channel names defined on the radio node
//enabledModules: List of active module plugins to load on startup

weather.//weatherAlarm: Time of day (HH:MM) to automatically run and broadcast the daily weather forecast
weather.//userAgent: Unique User-Agent header string required by the National Weather Service (NWS) API
weather.//zipCode: ZIP code used for daily forecasts and lightning tracking
weather.//myPosition: GPS coordinates used for Blitzortung lightning distance calculations
weather.//timers: Interval periods in milliseconds for checking updates

timers.//blitzCollection: Interval (ms) for lightning storm tracking runs
timers.//meteoAlerts: Interval (ms) for querying NWS severe weather alerts

weather.//blitzRadiusMiles: Storm alert threshold distance in miles around your position

meteoAlerts.//enabled: Toggle to enable/disable automated weather alerts checking and broadcasts
meteoAlerts.//timeout: Alert cooldown timeout in minutes to avoid repeat broadcasts
meteoAlerts.//severityFilter: Severity thresholds from NWS to broadcast
meteoAlerts.//certaintyFilter: Certainty thresholds from NWS to broadcast

mqtt.//iataCode: Local airport IATA code used for identifying packet source topics
mqtt.//privateKey: Optional 64-byte private key hex (scalar || prefix) for offline signature generation (leave blank to query device)
mqtt.//enabledPresets: MQTT presets to enable by default (e.g. ntxmesh, meshmapper, analyzer-us)
mqtt.//customBrokers: Custom private observers/brokers to connect and upload frames to
